title: Calls that set up the next step

scenes.title: Calls that set up the next step
scenes.subtitle: Missed, answered or voicemail: nothing falls through
scenes.narration: Every phone call ends with a next step. The assistant makes sure it is written down, whether the call was answered, missed or went to voicemail.

scenes.title: UK, US, Australia, Singapore
scenes.subtitle: Calls in this film are played by the local call simulator
scenes.narration: Calling is offered to agencies in the UK, the US, Australia and Singapore. The calls in this film are played by the local test simulator, through the same steps a real call takes.
Charlotte called while everyone was busy. A call-back task is created for her lead's owner, and a short sorry-we-missed-you message is drafted, waiting for your OK.
A number nobody knows called and hung up. The assistant offers to turn it into a contact and a lead, so a new enquiry is not lost.
After hours, callers can leave a voicemail. Each one becomes a task to listen and call back.
Tom calls about his Rajasthan trip and talks for a while. The call goes on his lead's timeline, the new lead moves to Contacted, and a follow-up is suggested.
A first-time caller has a real conversation with your team. Afterwards the assistant offers to create the contact and the lead from that call.

scenes.heading: Every call ends with a next step
scenes.narration: The pattern is always the same: the call lands on the timeline, the next step is prepared, and you approve it. If you call out and nobody answers, it suggests trying again.

scenes.headline: No call without a next step.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. No call without a next step.
